title: Customer reports of when incidents happened
summary: These fragments mainly note the timing, recurrence, or recent absence of unspecified incidents without enough detail to determine a clear evaluative sentiment.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews describe when something happened, how often it recurred, or that it had not happened again, but they do not specify the underlying issue well enough to classify sentiment.

limitations: All sampled fragments are undetermined, so the topic reflects incident timing and recurrence language rather than a clearly identified customer opinion.
The examples do not consistently identify the underlying problem, so concrete aspect-level conclusions are limited.
Some fragments are loosely related by wording such as 'happened' or 'occurred' and may group multiple unrelated situations.
